title: Some Kind of Heaven
review: It’s nice, beautifully shot and everything but I can’t help but feel the way Oppenheimer chose to shoot and edit this was very manipulative. It’s like he set out to tell a fictional story and edited these people’s lives to adhere to it. That’s probably not what he really did but that’s how it comes off to me.

title: White House Down
review: Extremely predictable die hard rip off

title: How to Rob a Bank
review: It’s fun but a lot of that fun goes away when it tries to take its bank robbers way too seriously. The tone for the cops is way better, John C Reilly and Zoe Kravitz are far and way the best part of this movie. Also I’m sick of seeing TikTok social media reaction montages in movies. It’s at least in services of the YouTube videos which are their own kind of fun. Wish it was more like Point Break.

title: Wildwood
review: The stop motion is so good it’s hard to fathom wow. Original unique fantasy story. It can be a little unfocused at times and there are a couple voice acting performances that stick out but it’s pretty immersive.

title: Club Kid
review: At the beginning I was like wow it’s gonna take a pretty good movie to make me feel empathy for this character and by the end of it I felt empathy for him so. A little predictable but most family dramas are, and it has enough laughs and moments of levity to keep it grounded. Yeah I went into this thinking I wasn’t gonna like it and ended up liking it quite a bit.

title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
review: Usually I like a simple crime story but there was just not enough there for me to call this good. The whole analog vs digital comes off as tired.
